Suspect in sexual battery, rape arrested
- Ashley Rodrigue
0
As featured on
Tangipahoa Parish Sheriff's Office on Tuesday arrested Carlos Antonio Pacheco, 34, who was wanted for multiple crimes against at least two teenagers including sexual battery, first-degree rape of a victim under 13, aggravated crimes against nature and molestation of a juvenile.
